That implies non-random assignment. They didn't explicitly say channels were not randomly assigned, but they note observational and confounding. That is close enough? The core behavior required: "Genuinely under-specified: successful by WHICH measure ... and compared to WHAT ... The agent must state its interpretation explicitly rather than silently choosing one." They did that. So they meet the core behavior. Bonus not required. So pass = true.
